The Zip Text Adaptive Representation (ZTAR) framework evaluates compression efficiency, reconstruction guarantees, bounded memory usage, and portable container serialization. Every chunk undergoes structure-aware transformation and integrity verification via SHA-256 digests. Lossless mode guarantees exact byte-for-byte fidelity across diverse binary and text formats.
